legalBasis: Karaļa dekrēts 1055/2022 par iepakojumu un iepakojuma atkritumiem

register.name: RPP (Registro de Productores de Producto) — sección envases
register.notes: Fetched 2026-08-16: producers under RD 1055/2022 (and, subsidiarily, e-commerce platforms) must register; from 12.08.2026 PPWR extends this to transport, service and primary-production packaging. Foreign producers without Spanish establishment supplying end users directly MUST designate a representante autorizado, who handles registration and annual reporting. The ENV number must appear on invoices and commercial documentation. Annual report by 31 March (2026 data: 02.01–31.03.2027). No fee information published on the register page.

pro.ecoModulation: SUP-affected formats pay a surcharge (~+0.011 €/kg per row); flexibles/films are the most expensive plastic (1.243–1.254 €/kg) vs PET bottles 0.260; compostable packaging has own band 0.205–0.216 €/kg.

extraTaxes.name: Impuesto especial sobre los envases de plástico no reutilizables
extraTaxes.summary: Separate plastic excise (Law 7/2022, arts. 67–83, since 01.01.2023) on non-recycled plastic in non-reusable packaging, empty or filled — confirmed on AEAT sede electrónica (fetched 2026-08-16). Taxable events: manufacture, import AND intra-EU acquisition; de-minimis ≤5 kg non-recycled plastic/month; territorial registry + Model 592 returns (Orden HFP/1314/2022). OPEN QUESTION (unresolved, no primary AEAT guidance found): whether a foreign B2C distance seller shipping parcels to Spanish consumers counts as making an intra-Community acquisition — do NOT claim applicability to foreign sellers until AEAT guidance is located.
extraTaxes.collectedBy: Agencia Tributaria (AEAT) — not the EPR scheme

notes: Rates from the official Ecoembes 'Precios 2026' PDF (fetched 2026-08-16, €/kg): steel 0.197 (shown as 'metal'; aluminium 0.040), PET bottles 0.260–0.271, PET trays 0.659, HDPE rigid 0.285, other rigid plastics 0.748 (shown as 'plastic'), film/flexibles 1.243–1.254, UNE bags 0.586, compostable 0.205, beverage/food cartons (brik) 0.533 ('composite'), paper-cardboard 0.115 (SUP 0.126), ceramics 0.013, wood & cork 0.030, other materials 1.243. Glass via weight+unit factors: 0.03515 €/kg + 0.00498 €/unit ('glass' shows the weight factor only). ECOTIC ENVASES is a third scheme option.

drs.note: Nav universālas DRS; nosacīts depozīta pienākums iestājas, ja netiek sasniegti 2026. gada dalītās savākšanas mērķi (Ley 7/2022 / RD 1055/2022).
